Regge.prescription: Continue the complete Euclidean Regge+boundary action along metric diag(exp(-i alpha),1,1,1), alpha0..pi-epsilon. Track each square root and arccos sheet continuously; include actual boundary exterior angles. No flat-value subtraction. Geometry is one Lorentzian1to5 simplex refinement, not the prior nine-simplex action.
Regge.limits: A finite complex continuation on a declared sheet and time orientation. Correct flat stationarity and geometric-motion Ward controls are necessary, not a proof of reflection positivity, causal quantum dynamics, all-triangulation uniqueness or nonlinear Hamiltonian constraint closure. No lapse/shift Poisson algebra is constructed.

measure_boundary: Actual4D Wilson/overlap projector family over two periodic boundary-link torons, with flux34. Discrete determinant-link Chern calculation; mesh/gap/overlap diagnostics exported. A nonzero Chern number obstructs one global smooth basis for that representation. Opposite-charge sums test vectorlike cancellation only. No local reconstruction current, anomaly-free chiral full-sector measure or continuum limit follows from this finite test.
